steps.text: Where a tanner works hides beside a roaring furnace, in the town behind the toll gate, dig on the ground right next to that furnace.
The king of Varrock keeps twin fountains in his palace garden. Dig on the path between the two fountains.
Two furnaces glow side by side in the White Knights city. Dig on the ground in the gap between them.
North of the castle where Duke Horacio rules, a furnace stands near the fishing spots. Dig beside that furnace.
A witch brews her potions in Rimmington. Dig inside her house, right beside her bubbling cauldron.
In the village of the long-haired barbarians, wool becomes balls on a spinning wheel. Dig right next to it.
This anagram reveals who to speak to next: NASH
This anagram reveals who to speak to next: YUBARU
This anagram reveals who to speak to next: KIVROH
I sell axes near Lumbridge and my name reads the same forwards and backwards. Speak to me.
Speak to the grocer of the port town of Sarim, who sells bananas and cabbages and guards a back room full of crates.
A dwarf who loves his anvil lives in a house north of Falador, near the white-knights road. Speak to him.
Search the cupboard behind the bar of the Blue Moon Inn, where a doctor drinks his ale in Varrock.
Reldo guards old stories in the king palace in Varrock. Search the bookcase in his library.
A knight named Prysin keeps a chest in the Varrock palace. Search it.
A priest tends the altar of the Varrock church. Search the cupboard in his church.
Fruit and greens fill the grocer shop of Port Sarim. Search the crate in the back room of the food store.
Nets, rods and harpoons are sold at a shop on the Port Sarim docks. Search the cupboard there.
Druids chant in a stone circle just north of Taverley. Dig on the ground within the circle of standing stones.
In the East Ardougne market, silver and gems are traded just metres apart. Dig on the ground between the silver stall and the gem stall.
Karamja grows its bananas in neat rows. Dig in the middle of the plantation, where the trees are planted in a grid.
Where a king keeps a round table, fountains play in the castle garden. Dig on the ground midway between them.
Bees hum in a quiet garden near the village of seers. Dig on the ground right next to the beehive.
Fish on one side and arrows on the other: in Catherby, dig on the street between the fishing shop and the archery shop.
This anagram reveals who to speak to next: FAWNES
The ruler of Camelot sits at a round table with his noble knights. Speak to the king himself.
This anagram reveals who to speak to next: ZEN SHEA
This anagram reveals who to speak to next: NOVAD
This anagram reveals who to speak to next: TONHICK
Fruit pickers on Karamja answer to one man who pays them in coin for every crate of bananas. Speak to the plantation owner.
Spiders spin their webs in the haunted manor north of Draynor. Search the cupboard in the room where a rat scuttles.
Some keep their secrets under their feet. In Taverley, search the door mat at the entrance of the house.
Crates are stacked at the quay in Catherby beside the general store. Search the one beside the shopkeeper.
Bankers count their coins at the southern end of East Ardougne. Search the crate beside the bank.
A brother guards the cogs of the clock tower south of Ardougne. Search the cupboard in the tower.
On the island of Brimhaven, amulets are sold in a shop near the docks. Search the cupboard in the shop.

steps.danger: Demonic Ruins, Wilderness level 45: aggressive greater and lesser demons, open to player attackers
steps.text: Broken pillars ring a ruin where horned demons roam the far Wilderness. Dig in the rubble between the pillars.

steps.danger: Deserted Keep, far northern Wilderness level 53: king scorpions, giant bats and player killers
steps.text: An abandoned keep stands at the far northern edge of the Wilderness. Dig on the ground just outside its walls.

steps.danger: Pirates hut, deep Wilderness level 55: aggressive pirates, no easy way out
steps.text: Pirates hide their loot in a hut at the edge of the world. Dig on the ground outside the hut, away from their cutlasses.

steps.danger: Frozen Waste Plateau, Wilderness level 50: aggressive ice giants, ice warriors and ice spiders
steps.text: High on the frozen plateau where giants of ice stomp, dig upon the snowy ground between the ice giants.

steps.danger: Bone Yard, Wilderness level 29: aggressive skeletons and wandering player killers
steps.text: Beasts of the Wilderness come to die in a yard of bones. Dig on the ground beside the animal skull among the bones.

steps.danger: Bandit Camp, Wilderness level 22: aggressive bandits and player killers
steps.text: This anagram reveals who to speak to next: TERZONAZO

steps.danger: Bandit Camp, Wilderness level 24: aggressive bandits and player killers
steps.text: A portly pizza chef cooks for the bandits in a camp of the Wilderness. Find the heavy Italian-style cook to learn more.

steps.danger: Bandit Camp, Wilderness level 22: aggressive bandits and player killers
steps.text: The swiftest of the bandit leaders, whose pace is his name, holds the next clue in a Wilderness camp.

steps.danger: Tai Bwo Wannai, deep Karamja jungle: aggressive jungle spiders, jogres and hobgoblins on the paths
steps.text: This anagram reveals who to speak to next: FUTURIST

steps.danger: Pirates hut, deep Wilderness level 55: aggressive pirates, no easy way out
steps.text: Open the northernmost chest on the east wall of the pirates hut at the far edge of the Wilderness.

steps.danger: Axe hut, deep Wilderness level 54: aggressive animated axes
steps.text: Animated axes lurk in a hut in the deep Wilderness. Open the chest that stands alone, apart from its two neighbours.

steps.danger: Chaos Temple, Wilderness level 11: attackable by players, aggressive wanderers
steps.text: North of Varrock, in the Wilderness, a dark temple has an altar for a god of chaos. Search the altar.

steps.danger: Demonic Ruins, Wilderness level 45: aggressive greater demons hit very hard
steps.text: Among the shattered pillars a horned beast of immense size guards the next clue. Slay the greater demon of the ruins.

steps.danger: Wilderness level 42: aggressive lesser demons, open to player attackers
steps.text: A lesser fiend of flame roams the far Wilderness. Slay a lesser demon to claim the next clue.

steps.danger: Wilderness level 38: aggressive moss giants, player killers
steps.text: A great mossy brute prowls the deep Wilderness near the isle of the red dragons. Slay a moss giant to win the next clue.

steps.danger: Frozen Waste Plateau, Wilderness level 50: aggressive ice giants, warriors and spiders
steps.text: Giants of ice stalk the frozen plateau. Slay one of them and its frosty hoard will hold the next clue.

steps.danger: Wilderness level 20: black unicorns flee and wolves and player killers roam
steps.text: A herd of dark horned horses grazes in the Wilderness north of Varrock. Slay a black unicorn to find the next clue.

steps.danger: Wilderness level 31: aggressive chaos dwarves, player killers
steps.text: Dwarves who serve chaos dig in the Wilderness north of the Bandit Camp. Slay a chaos dwarf to claim the next clue.
